row.problem_statement:
JSONHandler produces broken output
Exporting in JSON format gives you this:

```
{
{"test": "tester", "author": "bob", "something": "else"}
}

Title
=====

title2
------

Hello.

Just need three dashes
---

And this might break.
```

So that's unfortunate.
